proposal.reasoning: The purchase order PO-77812 for part P-4471 has a promised delivery date of September 4, 2026. However, the supplier email (sent at 2026-09-01) states that the revised ship date is September 7, which will delay it beyond the needed date for production order 4812. The quantity needed for the production order is 120, which can be rerouted to ensure timely delivery from an alternate supplier.
proposal.summary_for_user: The original purchase order PO-77812 for part P-4471 is at risk of delay, and I propose to reroute 120 units to ensure production order 4812 can be fulfilled on time.

justification: Meridian Drives is the only pre-approved candidate, with a fast lead time of 2 days for urgent parts reroute.

body:
Dear Production Team,

Please be informed that the parts for production order #4812 have been rerouted to the new supplier S-Z. This change is effective immediately, and we appreciate your prompt attention to this adjustment.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
